t: Said going down into prostration at night
a: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ سَجَدَ وَجْهِي لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ وَصَوَّرَهُ وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ
p: Allāhumma laka sajadtu wa bika āmantu wa laka aslamt. Sajada wajhī lilladhī khalaqahu wa ṣawwarahu wa shaqqa samʿahu wa baṣarah.
m: O Allah, to You I have prostrated, in You I have believed, to You I have submitted. My face has prostrated to the One who created it and formed it and opened its hearing and sight.
